questions.questionText: Balance the following chemical equation: N2 + H2 -> NH3
questions.studentAnswer: N2 + 3H2 -> 2NH3. This is balanced because there are 2 nitrogen atoms and 6 hydrogen atoms on both sides of the equation.

questions.questionText: State the type of chemical reaction that occurs when a candle burns in air, and name the products formed.
questions.studentAnswer: This is a combustion reaction. The wax (a hydrocarbon) reacts with oxygen in the air to produce carbon dioxide and water vapor, releasing heat and light.

questions.questionText: Balance the following chemical equation: Fe + O2 -> Fe2O3
questions.studentAnswer: 4Fe + 3O2 -> 4Fe2O3. I balanced the iron and oxygen atoms on the reactant side using coefficients 4 and 3.

questions.questionText: Calculate the pH of a solution with hydrogen ion concentration [H+] = 1 x 10^-4 M.
questions.studentAnswer: pH = -log[H+] = -log(10^-4) = -4. So the pH of the solution is -4.

questions.questionText: Name the gas evolved when dilute hydrochloric acid reacts with zinc granules, and describe one test to identify it.
questions.studentAnswer: Oxygen gas is evolved when zinc reacts with dilute HCl. To test for it, bring a glowing splint near the mouth of the test tube the splint will relight, confirming the gas is oxygen.
